name: United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List
operator: United Nations Security Council (Security Council Affairs Division, UN Secretariat)
tier_rationale: Intergovernmental body (A8 trusted: government bodies). 'Providers (dataset downloads, no value sent): OFAC/US Treasury, UN Security Council and the European Commission, all trusted tier.' (P219 cond 2). The Azure blob host is the UN's own publication storage: consolidated.xml answers 302 to a SAS URL on it (verified 2026-11-26).

reliability.justification: The authoritative consolidated list of the Security Council sanctions committees (binding in Brazil through Lei 13.810/2019); regenerated daily even without changes.

error_markers.reason: UN sanctions list: the Azure storage refused the signed download link (SAS expired or invalid): request the list again (v3lum data update sanctions)

consolidated.title: UN Security Council Consolidated List (consolidated.xml; dataset matched locally)

terms.quote: Sources: OFAC SDN CSV from the Sanctions List Service (US government work, public domain), UN consolidated XML (UN public information) and EU FSF CSV (EU open data, reuse with attribution; the Commission's public token is a config value).

consolidated.notes: Quote: binding council text (P219 cond 1); research C0521 terms 'UN public information'. Dataset sanctions_un_consolidated (2.2 MB XML, dateGenerated regenerated daily: compare sha256 for real changes), TTL 24 h through the dataset manager (`v3lum data update sanctions`), never downloaded during a scan; parsed with the safe XML helper (DOCTYPE/entity declarations refused, size and depth caps; P219 cond 5). Attribution line in reports (P219 cond 12). Used by sanctions_lists (batch p1-G10-1).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-1 (P219 sanctions_lists). Dataset downloads only: no investigated value is ever sent. GET https://scsanctions.un.org/resources/xml/en/consolidated.xml answers 302 to unsolprodfiles.blob.core.windows.net with SAS parameters (sig is redacted by the core; se/st/sv are not secrets).
